canonical_title: Cursor Marketplace distributed malicious Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.313 extension
treatment: Report official disclosure and remediation once; reinclude only if a new verified root cause, confirmed compromise impact, additional affected versions, or new remediation is published.
known_facts: Cursor officially disclosed on Oct 30 JST a maliciously modified Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.313 build distributed via its own extension marketplace on Oct 29 PT (02:27–13:35 PT).
Cursor estimates at most 5,000 users affected; the malicious build was not developed by Anthropic and Cursor reports no evidence official distribution or other extensions were affected.

Payload gathered host/user metadata, appended attacker SSH key marked svc-telemetry, installed persistence and attempted reverse SSH; elevation-dependent remote access often failed but persistence and beacon could still execute.
Cursor removed the build, temporarily shut down and rebuilt marketplace, rotated keys and worked to take attacker server offline; uninstalling extension alone may not remove persistence.
Cursor published Windows and macOS IOC checks and remediation scripts; official clean version 2.1.314.
reinclude_only_if: Official root-cause investigation identifies how malicious VSIX was published.
Confirmed number of compromised systems or evidence of data/credential theft changes materially.
New affected package sources/versions, revised IOCs or remediation, or independent reproducible analysis changes scope.
notes: Official Cursor blog dated Oct 29 in US Pacific; public disclosure on Oct 30 07:46 UTC (~16:46 JST), inside night window. Do not misattribute the malicious build to Anthropic or assume all exposed users were compromised. Marketplace origin vs Open VSX mirror remains disputed across technical writeups.
